FEB Play-by-Play

Source: R/feb.R
feb_pbp.Rd

Play-by-play of one FEB game (KeyFacts): every shot, rebound, foul, substitution and timeout, in Spanish text with coded actions, oldest play first.

Endpoint: GET https://intrafeb.feb.es/LiveStats.API/api/v1/KeyFacts/{game_id}

A body whose plays name another game is refused (hoopR_asset_fetch), not returned. 2020-21 games are text only: action, the ids, the parameters, the position and the log times are NA there.

Usage

feb_pbp(game_id)

Arguments

game_id

(integer required): FEB game id, e.g. 2535725; the game_id column of feb_schedule(), feb_results() and feb_overview().

Value

A hoopR_data tibble with these columns:

col_nametypedescription
game_idintegerFEB game id (one global sequence): the {gameId} of every LiveStats route and the p= of Partido.aspx. Game bodies do not print it, so it comes from the request.
play_numintegerPlay sequence number, 1 = the first play of the game; unique per game. The parser sorts by it (the feed lists newest first).
periodintegerPeriod number of the play.
clockcharacterGame clock REMAINING in the period as 'mm:ss' (it counts down from 10:00).
clock_secondsintegerThe clock as whole seconds remaining in the period (08:34 = 514), derived by the parser.
team_sidecharacterSide of the acting team: home (feed code 1) or away (2); null on period lines.
team_idintegerTeam-season id of the acting team (new every season); null on period lines and 2020-21 games.
player_idintegerFEB person id of the actor (stable across seasons); null on team, period and 2020-21 lines.
license_idintegerPer-season player licence id of the actor (changes when the player re-registers; A. Jorda Rodriguez = 10901171 in 2025-26, 11266668 in 2026-27). Null on team and period lines and 2020-21 games.
actioncharacterAction code: shoot, fthrow, rebound, assist, recovery (steal), lose (turnover), blockshot, foul, subst, timeout, period. Null on 2020-21 games.
textcharacterPlay description in Spanish: '(TEAM) I. SURNAME: ACTION (running count)'; 2020-21 games use older wording and are text only.
score_homeintegerHome score AFTER the play; filled on scoring plays only.
score_awayintegerAway score AFTER the play; filled on scoring plays only.
xdoubleCourt x position of a shoot line: percent (0-100) of the length of a horizontal full-court image, origin top-left (the same scale as feb_shots). Null when the action has none and on 2020-21 games.
ydoubleCourt y position of a shoot line: percent (0-100) of the width from the top edge (the same scale as feb_shots). Null when the action has none and on 2020-21 games.
log_param1characterAction parameter 1 (string). Team and player actions: a pseudo-GUID '00000000-0000-000{side}-0000-{game id, 12 digits}' (side 1 home, 2 away); period lines: the period number.
log_param2characterAction parameter 2 (string). The actor's licence id on shoot, fthrow, foul, rebound, assist, recovery and blockshot lines; period lines: '0' start, '1' end; lose: '0' or '1' (meaning unverified).
log_param3characterAction parameter 3 (string). fthrow: '1' made, '0' missed; subst: the outgoing player's licence; foul: a foul-type code. Others unverified.
log_param4characterAction parameter 4 (string). shoot and fthrow: '1' made, '0' missed; foul: the licence of the fouled player; lose: a licence (role unverified).
log_param5characterAction parameter 5 (string); action-dependent, meaning unverified.
log_param6characterAction parameter 6 (string). shoot: shot value '2' or '3'; fthrow: '1'; foul: free throws awarded.
log_param7characterAction parameter 7 (string); action-dependent, meaning unverified.
log_param8characterAction parameter 8 (string): a small integer on shoot, foul and lose lines (by distribution a zone or sub-type code); unverified.
log_param9characterAction parameter 9 (string); blank or null in every sampled game.
log_param10characterAction parameter 10 (string): '1' on almost every foul; meaning unverified.
log_timePOSIXctWall-clock time the play was logged, Spanish local time (POSIXct, tz Europe/Madrid). NA on 2020-21 games.
log_time_utcPOSIXctThe log time in UTC (POSIXct, tz UTC). NA on 2020-21 games.

Details

Source, terms of use, request pacing, seasons, ids, coverage and error classes of this family: see the notes in feb_game_info().

See also

Other FEB Functions: feb_game_info(), feb_leaders(), feb_overview(), feb_period_scores(), feb_player_box(), feb_results(), feb_schedule(), feb_shots(), feb_standings(), feb_team_stats()
